name: day-one
title: Day One
description: Search, write, and sync your Day One journals and Daily Chat with the Day One CLI
author: AntonNiklasson

commands.name: search-entries
commands.title: Search Entries
commands.subtitle: Day One
commands.description: Search your Day One entries by meaning, or browse the newest ones

commands.name: add-entry
commands.title: Add Entry
commands.subtitle: Day One
commands.description: Write a new entry in one of your Day One journals

preferences.name: syncAfterSaving
preferences.title: Sync
preferences.label: Sync after saving
preferences.description: Upload the new entry to Day One right away

commands.name: add-to-daily-chat
commands.title: Add to Daily Chat
commands.subtitle: Day One
commands.description: Add a message to today's Daily Chat in Day One

commands.name: sync
commands.title: Sync Day One
commands.subtitle: Day One
commands.description: Download new entries and upload the ones you wrote here

commands.name: doctor
commands.title: Run Doctor
commands.subtitle: Day One
commands.description: Install the Day One CLI, sign in, and fix setup problems

tools.name: list-journals
tools.title: List Journals
tools.description: List the user's Day One journals with their IDs and names.

tools.name: search-entries
tools.title: Search Entries
tools.description: Search the user's Day One entries by meaning, with optional journal, tag, and date filters. Returns each entry's ID, journal, date, tags, and text.

tools.name: get-entry
tools.title: Get Entry
tools.description: Read one Day One entry in full by its entry ID.

tools.name: create-entry
tools.title: Create Entry
tools.description: Write a new entry in one of the user's Day One journals. Asks the user to confirm first.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Day One CLI
preferences.description: Leave empty to find the Day One CLI automatically

preferences.name: verboseLogging
preferences.title: Debug Logging
preferences.label: Enable extra diagnostics in the console
preferences.description: Show detailed logs in the console for debugging.

preferences.name: strictRedaction
preferences.title: Strict Redaction
preferences.label: Also hide URL query strings and fragments in logs
preferences.description: Turn on before reproducing an issue, then share only the new log lines.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
